name: Potion Sort
storyline: A witch's shop at night. Moonlight falls through the window, lanterns sway under the beams… and the floor is covered in vials. The toad, perched on the counter in its pointy hat, pretends nothing happened. From the little Vial Shop to the Back Room and finally the Great Storeroom with its bubbling cauldron, every potion has to find its way back home.
summary:
Potion Sort is a cozy first-person tidying game. The witch's toad has knocked over her entire stock, and it's up to you to pick up every vial and put it back on the right shelf. There's no timer and no way to fail: just 1,320 physical vials that roll, clink and pile up across three rooms, and the quiet satisfaction of a shelf lighting up once it's complete.

Tell 36 different potions apart by colour, bottle shape and label symbol, each with its own living liquid: nacre that sloshes, gold glitter, bubbles, pulsing embers. Along the way, uncover 21 secrets hidden around the shop. A free demo is available.
